name: Touri
source:
[b]The Sister Maid: Charming All Hearts, Devoted to One[/b]

One of the orphans who grew up with her "Onii-chan" Nagi at the Sugara District orphanage. While Nagi took one route into Ougen Academy, Touri found her own way to slip through the cracks - all to keep an eye on him and watch his back.

Touri's gentle nature makes her a natural charmer, winning hearts wherever she goes. But beneath that soft exterior lie nerves of steel forged in Sugara District's tough streets. Nothing fazes her; she takes everything in stride.

Around Nagi, though, Touri shows her true colors. This typically easy-going girl becomes a force of nature where he's concerned - revealing a bold streak that leaves others stunned.

"When you're starving and finally get to eat... that first bite just hits different. Can't beat that feeling."

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://selectoblige.com/character]official website[/url]]
